results.title: Russia is selling gas to China at half price — because it has to.
results.description:
Russia is selling gas to China at half price — because it has to.

Duma documents show Beijing pays about $248 per 1,000 cubic metres for Gazprom pipeline gas in 2026, vs $562 for other foreign buyers. A 56% discount.

That is what losing your best customer looks like.

results.title: The map satirizes EU policy: direct Russian pipeline gas labeled "bad," while the same resource flows to China as "good." Logic is geopoliti
results.description:
The map satirizes EU policy: direct Russian pipeline gas labeled "bad," while the same resource flows to China as "good."

Logic is geopolitical. After 2022 cutoffs weaponized dependence, EU cut pipeline imports ~90% (share from ~40% to ~10-15%). Remaining LNG under old contracts is being phased out fully by Jan 2027, pipeline by late 2027, to deny Russia leverage and war revenue without instant market shock.

China takes Power of Siberia at capacity (~39 bcm) at steep discounts; long-haul LNG routes are costly and tanker-limited, so volumes stay lower. Costly for EU industry, but deliberate decoupling rather than pure idiocy.
